{{Top|leg}}
A '''power lift''' was a piece of equipment that disassembled [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] could rest upon. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the empire had several power lifts in the vehicle testing lab of its [[Aquaculture Facility]] on [[Uridia]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Uridia system/Legends|Uridia system]].<ref name="Ando Project">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Power lifts appeared in "[[The Ando Project]]," adventure for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Chris Doyle]] and published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh]] issue of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal]].<ref name="Ando Project" />
